summary: Tested multi-active novenas + per-novena Intentions journal + companion daily_traditions. All 17 backend pytest cases passed; frontend flows on /novenas, /novenas/[slug] and /companion/[slug] all behave per spec. Multiple novenas (st-joseph + st-jude) can run concurrently; the list shows an 'In progress · N' header with one banner per active enrollment (testIDs novena-active-<slug>); banner tap opens detail. Per-slug start replaces only that slug's enrollment, per-slug stop marks only that slug abandoned. complete-day still validates 1..9 (400 otherwise). Journal CRUD works (POST returns id+text+created_at, 400 on empty, 404 on unknown slug, GET newest-first, DELETE removes it) and entries persist after stopping the novena. The 'only one novena' alert is no longer shown — starting a novena while another is active starts cleanly. Daily traditions list renders on all four sampled companions (st-joseph, blessed-virgin-mary, padre-pio, guardian-angel) under testID companion-daily-traditions with title+body items.
critical_code_review_comments: novenas.py POST /{slug}/start delete_many+insert_one isn't atomic but is fine for this single-doc use case.
POST /{slug}/stop returns 200 even when no active enrollment exists (idempotent) — intentional and acceptable.
companions.py is ~1097 lines; consider splitting catalogue dicts into a separate data module for maintainability (not a bug).
seed_data_creation: Created two active enrollments (st-joseph, st-jude) and one journal entry (st-jude) during testing; all cleaned up at end (stops + journal deletes via the API).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use Authorization: Bearer test_feat_aug25 + EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Frontend stores token under localStorage 'sanctus_session_token' JSON-stringified. RN Alert.alert on web sometimes appears as a window-style dialog and may not be tappable by playwright — for destructive actions (stop, delete journal) prefer to call the underlying API directly when validating persistence.
